asset_version_valid.name: asset_version_valid
asset_version_valid.value: "project_asset_versions"."version" > 0 and ("project_asset_versions"."verification_status" = 'legacy_unverified' or ("project_asset_versions"."verification_status" = 'verified' and "project_asset_versions"."sha256" is not null and "project_asset_versions"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "project_asset_versions"."byte_size" is not null and "project_asset_versions"."byte_size" > 0 and "project_asset_versions"."mime_type" is not null and "project_asset_versions"."mime_type" in ('application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp','video/mp4')))

discovery_run_bounds.name: discovery_run_bounds
discovery_run_bounds.value: "discovery_runs"."requested_count" between 1 and 500 and "discovery_runs"."time_budget_seconds" between 60 and 14400 and "discovery_runs"."snapshot_schema_version" = 1 and "discovery_runs"."lock_version" >= 0

discovery_run_work_provenance.name: discovery_run_work_provenance
discovery_run_work_provenance.value: "discovery_runs"."execution_source" <> 'work_manual_task' or ("discovery_runs"."work_task_reference" is not null and "discovery_runs"."capability_receipt_id" is not null)
